title: "CCMI Showcase"
author: "Colin Cotter"
date: "06/10/2026"
summary: "Our first annual CCMI Showcase!"
categories: [News]

---

Today we took over the London Geological Society at Burlington
House for the first CCMI Showcase event. Our first cohort presented
exciting posters about their PhD research, and we had an inspiring
talk from Ewan Kirk, Founder of Cantab Capital Partners and the former
chair of the Isaac Newton Institute, who talked about his career and
his joy for software and computational modelling.
